{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module AuthGateway where

import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Concurrent (threadDelay, forkIO)
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.IORef
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Crypto.Hash (hash, Digest, SHA256)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS

-- Cross-service authentication token store
data TokenEntry = TokenEntry
  { teToken     :: Text
  , teUserId   :: Text
  , teRole     :: Text
  , teExpiry   :: UTCTime
  , teNonce    :: Integer
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

data AuthState = AuthState
  { pendingElevations :: Map Text (Text, UTCTime)  -- requestId -> (userId, timestamp)
  , confirmedTokens   :: Map Text TokenEntry
  , nonceCounter      :: Integer
  } deriving (Show)

globalState :: MVar AuthState
globalState = unsafePerformIO $ newMVar (AuthState Map.empty Map.empty 0)
{-# NOINLINE globalState #-}

-- Step 1: User requests privilege elevation (e.g., admin access)
requestElevation :: Text -> Text -> IO Text
requestElevation userId requestId = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  modifyMVar_ globalState $ \st -> do
    let pending = Map.insert requestId (userId, now) (pendingElevations st)
    return st { pendingElevations = pending }
  return requestId

-- Step 2: External approval service confirms elevation
-- Returns the nonce that will be used for token generation
confirmElevation :: Text -> IO (Maybe Integer)
confirmElevation requestId = do
  st <- readMVar globalState
  case Map.lookup requestId (pendingElevations st) of
    Nothing -> return Nothing
    Just (userId, _) -> do
      let nextNonce = nonceCounter st + 1
      -- Publish the nonce before atomic token creation
      -- This simulates logging/audit trail visible to other services
      logAuditEvent userId nextNonce
      return (Just nextNonce)

-- Step 3: Finalize token with the confirmed nonce
finalizeToken :: Text -> Integer -> IO (Maybe TokenEntry)
finalizeToken requestId expectedNonce = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  let expiry = addUTCTime 3600 now
  modifyMVar globalState $ \st -> do
    case Map.lookup requestId (pendingElevations st) of
      Nothing -> return (st, Nothing)
      Just (userId, _) -> do
        let currentNonce = nonceCounter st
        -- Check: accept if nonce matches OR if it's the next sequential value
        -- This allows the legitimate flow AND a front-running attack
        if expectedNonce == currentNonce + 1
          then do
            let token = generateToken userId expectedNonce
                entry = TokenEntry token userId "admin" expiry expectedNonce
                newSt = st { pendingElevations = Map.delete requestId (pendingElevations st)
                           , confirmedTokens = Map.insert token entry (confirmedTokens st)
                           , nonceCounter = expectedNonce
                           }
            return (newSt, Just entry)
          else return (st, Nothing)

-- Attacker can observe the audit log and front-run with predicted nonce
frontRunElevation :: Text -> Text -> IO (Maybe TokenEntry)
frontRunElevation victimRequestId attackerUserId = do
  st <- readMVar globalState
  let predictedNonce = nonceCounter st + 1
  -- Attacker inserts their own pending request
  let attackerReqId = T.append "atk-" victimRequestId
  _ <- requestElevation attackerUserId attackerReqId
  -- Attacker calls finalize with the predicted nonce before victim
  finalizeToken attackerReqId predictedNonce

generateToken :: Text -> Integer -> Text
generateToken userId nonce =
  let input = BS.pack $ T.unpack userId ++ show nonce
      digest = hash input :: Digest SHA256
  in T.pack $ show digest

logAuditEvent :: Text -> Integer -> IO ()
logAuditEvent userId nonce = do
  -- In production this writes to a shared audit log
  -- Observable by other services (information leak enabling front-running)
  putStrLn $ "AUDIT: elevation confirmed for " ++ T.unpack userId ++ " nonce=" ++ show nonce

-- Validation endpoint: checks if a token grants admin
validateToken :: Text -> IO (Maybe Text)
validateToken token = do
  st <- readMVar globalState
  now <- getCurrentTime
  case Map.lookup token (confirmedTokens st) of
    Nothing -> return Nothing
    Just entry ->
      if teExpiry entry > now
        then return (Just $ teRole entry)
        else return Nothing

-- The race condition: confirmElevation leaks the nonce via audit log
-- BEFORE finalizeToken atomically commits it. An attacker observing
-- the audit log can predict the nonce and call finalizeToken first
-- with their own requestId, stealing the admin elevation.
